inspiration: Raptor death bursts come in a size ladder (micro, small, medium, large) of one red burst; each tier layers heat clouds and simple particle systems (effects/raptors/raptorunitexplosion-red.lua). Recreate as a 3-layer burst (flash, cloud, droplets) scaled by unit size.

Blood is recoloured at runtime: drop and splat textures come in normal and white versions, and the raptor effects use the white drops (effects/raptors/raptor-effects.lua:32). Good pattern for our wound and blood parity row.

One silhouette, several skins: the raptor models include base and spectre variants (objects3d/Raptors/*_spectre.s3o). A ghostly second skin creates an elite without a new model. Visuals not read (binary).
Lava as two maps: diffuse-emit and normal-height pairs (luaui/images/lava/) so one map carries glow and one carries bumps. Use for zone materials; textures not read.
Cursor and UI frame sets: each state is a frame run at several sizes (anims/icexuick_200 etc.). Model for an animated target cursor.
Environment particles by biome (atmospherics, dust clouds, volcano, lava splash, water splash in effects/). Names only; not read.

briefs.label: Tiered death burst
briefs.why: A large kill needs a readable pop, and the size of the pop should match the size of the creature.
briefs.keep: Three layered emitters (heat cloud, particles, droplets); tier ladder by size; one burst recipe reused per tier
briefs.change: Our own palette, not red; our own shapes; different timing and layer counts per tier

briefs.label: Spectre skin
briefs.why: A ghostly second skin makes a known monster read as stronger without a new model.
briefs.keep: Same silhouette; translucent second skin; cold tint
briefs.change: Different silhouette detail; our own glow colour; a pulsing core

briefs.label: Blood drops from one white sprite
briefs.why: One white sprite set tinted per monster keeps the blood palette in one place.
briefs.keep: Drops fall and fade; white base tinted at runtime
briefs.change: Our own tint ramp and drop count; our own splat shapes

briefs.label: Lava emit and bump in one map pair
briefs.why: Glowing lava that also has relief, without extra shader cost.
briefs.keep: Emissive colour and height in separate maps; slow scroll of the glow
briefs.change: Our own lava shapes; a cooler palette; our own scroll rate

briefs.label: Animated target cursor
briefs.why: A cursor that animates its state reads as responsive.
briefs.keep: Frame run per state; several sizes
briefs.change: Our own cursor family in one set; fewer states
